decision.reasoning_trace: Among the 25 items, many were accessories like keychains, towels, or even a paddleboard, which narrowed the real backpack options significantly. I focused on tactical and outdoor rucksacks for the consideration set. The QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out as the clear winner due to its exceptional 4.7-star rating from over 6,000 reviews, high capacity, and competitive $39.99 price point. Compared to the Seibertron Falcon (prod_backpacks_107), it offers more storage for less money. The other rucksacks, like the Fox NATO style, were more basic, and the sling bags were better for short trips than general-purpose use.
